summary.text: Pat Daley is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 166 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Jesse Petrea.
A manufacturing professional and Wilmington Island resident, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include affordability, small businesses and access to affordable health care.

paragraphs.text: Pat Daley's Ballotpedia survey response says he earned a Bachelor of Science in Agricultural Engineering from the University of Georgia and a Master of Business Administration from Georgia Southern University.
It says he began his career in an entry-level manufacturing engineering role in the Savannah area and moved into management.
The response also says he has lived on the coastal Georgia islands for the past decade and is a resident of Wilmington Island.
Daley advanced from the Democratic primary for District 166 on May 19, 2026.
In the survey, he listed affordability and cost of living, support for local small businesses and affordable health care access as his key messages.
He also named health care and state finances as policy areas of interest, citing transparency, disciplined budgeting and long-term fiscal stability.
